description.zh: 无摩擦时动能与重力势能之和守恒，速度由高度差决定；有摩擦时减少的机械能变成热，E_p + E_k + Q 仍守恒；同一本账给出圆环的最低高度 2.5R、弹簧弹起高度和刹车距离 v²/(2μg)。质点模型，无空气阻力。
description.en: Without friction the sum of kinetic and gravitational potential energy is conserved and speed follows from the height difference; with friction the lost mechanical energy becomes heat and E_p + E_k + Q is still conserved; the same ledger gives the minimum loop height 2.5R, the height of a spring launch and the braking distance v²/(2μg). A point-mass model without air resistance.

label.zh: 功改变能量，摩擦做的功变成热
label.en: Work changes energy; friction’s work becomes heat

reason.zh: 外力或摩擦力做的功等于能量的变化；只有重力和弹力做功时机械能守恒，摩擦做功则把机械能转为内能。
reason.en: The work of outside forces or friction equals the change in energy; mechanical energy is conserved when only gravity and elastic forces do work, while friction turns it into internal energy.

label.zh: 同一结果可以从力和能量两条路得到
label.en: The same result by forces or by energy

reason.zh: 用牛顿第二定律沿轨道积分和用能量守恒得到同一个速度 √(2g(h₀ − h))，能量法不必知道轨道的形状。
reason.en: Integrating Newton’s second law along the track and using energy conservation give the same speed √(2g(h₀ − h)); the energy method does not need the shape of the track.

title.zh: 过山车为什么翻得过圆环？
title.en: Why does a roller coaster get round the loop?

ask.zh: 无摩擦时动能加势能守恒——过山车从高处冲下来，高度换成了什么？
ask.en: Without friction, kinetic plus potential energy is conserved — as the coaster dives from a height, what does the height turn into?

ask.zh: 冲上圆环顶端时，速度由高度差决定——为什么圆环的最低高度是 2.5R？
ask.en: Speed at the loop's top is set by the height difference — why must the start be at least 2.5R high?

ask.zh: 在圆环顶端，重力和支持力的合力提供向心力——如果速度太小，合力不够会怎样？
ask.en: At the loop's top, gravity plus the track's push supply the centripetal force — if the speed is too small and the net force falls short, what happens?

reveal.zh: 高度换成速度，冲上圆环需要足够的动能；2.5R 保证顶端仍有速度、合力仍能提供向心力，车才不会掉下来。
reveal.en: Height turns into speed, and climbing the loop needs enough kinetic energy; 2.5R guarantees speed remains at the top so the net force can still supply the centripetal force and the car stays on the track.
